title: Two Women Standing Outdoors, 1949 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot dated June 14, 1949, featuring two women posing together outdoors on a brick path in a yard surrounded by mature trees. The woman on the left wears a light shirtwaist dress and eyeglasses, while the woman on the right wears a patterned floral day dress and holds a purse. The photo provides a casual glimpse into American domestic life and everyday fashion in the post-WWII era.
